* Troubleshoot complex technical challenges across integrations, data pipelines and AI workflows.
* Collaborate closely with Product and Engineering to translate customer feedback into platform improvements.
* Help establish the tools, processes and best practices that will support a growing forward deployed engineering function.

* Good software engineering fundamentals and experience building production systems.
* Experience with AI/ML technologies, LLMs, AI agents or applied AI applications.
* Tech agnostic, working across different technology stacks, APIs and customer environments.
* Technical problem-solving skills, can turn open-ended challenges into practical solutions.
* Clear communication skills and confidence working directly with customers.
* Comfortable with ambiguity, autonomy and taking ownership in an early-stage start-up.
